// Synthetic net/http routes fixture; .txt prevents compilation.

package routes

import "net/http"

// RegisterRoutes wires the application's net/http routes.
func RegisterRoutes() {
	// Pre-Go-1.22 patterns (no leading verb).
	http.HandleFunc("/v1/health", healthHandler)
	http.Handle("/v1/static", staticHandler)

	// Go 1.22+ method-prefixed patterns.
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/orders/{id}", getOrder)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/orders", createOrder)
	mux.Handle("PUT /v1/orders/{id}", putHandler)
	mux.HandleFunc("DELETE /v1/orders/{id}", deleteOrder)
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/wild", wildHandler) // no leading verb → ANY

	// Anonymous closure handler.
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/anonymous", func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("inline"))
	})

	// Path starting with a word that looks like a verb but isn't —
	// must not be split. (Confidence: "FOO" isn't in httpVerbs.)
	mux.HandleFunc("FOO /v1/bogus", bogusHandler)
}

func healthHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {}
func getOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)      {}
func createOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)   {}
func deleteOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)   {}
func wildHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)   {}
func bogusHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)  {}

var (
	staticHandler http.Handler
	putHandler    http.Handler
)
